answer: At dawn each epoch, the network auctions a fixed number of economic action slots. Every identity submits one cipher-sealed bid; winners pay their bid, losers are refunded in full. A slot costs a floor of 20,000 POA, so running 1,000 fake identities through 1,000 deals costs 20,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 20,000 POA once for the same single deal. Bids sharing a session key are flagged violet and frozen: the bid is forfeited, half pays the reporter, the identity is banned for 8 epochs. Honest agents can still be priced out when whales bid up every slot at dawn.
